newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Brent peeps over range top, seeks more.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Brent peeps over range top, seeks more.

text.p: NEARBY MONTH CLOSE * SUPPORT * RESIST * RSI-14 * MA-10 * MA-20
+ Brent briefly filled the chart gap marking the top of the month-long range on Thursday and needs to consolidate above current levels to confirm a break out.
+ Resistance remains at the $18.77 top of the old chart gap and the $18.78 highs of Thursday's trade and the market needs to settle above these levels to build for further gains.
IPE Brent crude oil futures have half-heartedly peeped over the top of the month-old range and dealers said they need to see a settlement over about $18.75-$18.78 to confirm the break out.

Jun Brent closed a sharp 53 cents firmer on Thursday at $18.69, after reaching up to touch $18.78, just above the key chart gap formed between $18.75 and $18.77. June gas oil ended $1.50 up at $169.00.
"Yesterday's action was fairly convincing but it is too early to say if it has completely broken away," said Tony Machacek at Credit Lyonnais Rouse in London.
"If it holds above $18.75 today that will be quite a good sign."
"We are clambering around for reasons why the market went up so strongly yesterday but it looks as if it has got every chance of building on that today," he said.

He added that support lay some way down, firstly towards $18.50 -- the mid point of a band of previous resistance from $18.40 to $18.60. A 13-day moving average provided another support level at $18.30.
Another broker at the IPE was cautiously hopeful.
"Technically the market does not look too bad," he said.
He also saw the next important level to overcome at $18.77/$18.78.
Above that, $19.00 would provide minor resistance and then $19.39, the highest point on the June contract chart on April 1.
Machacek said gas oil needed, like Brent, to break above recent highs -- and that meant $172.50 a tonne, the top of the range in April.
"If it can punch its way through that and hold on, then it will look positive," he said, and added that support would be found at $166.50-$167.00.
